tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (5 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Five-drone coordination exercise: Drone 17, Drone 14, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 5 take off together to 22 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (483, 418, 22), (617, 465, 22), (810, 495, 22), (688, 685, 22), and (519, 698, 22) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all five drones move north for 84m, and next move east for 91m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 84m, then east 91m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 84m, east 91m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Five-drone formation drill: launch Drone 17, Drone 14, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 5 to altitude 22m, hold stations at (483, 418, 22), (617, 465, 22), (810, 495, 22), (688, 685, 22), and (519, 698, 22) respectively, then shift north by 84 meters and east by 91 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 17, Drone 14, Drone 19, Drone 2, Drone 5: take off reaching 22 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (483, 418, 22), (617, 465, 22), (810, 495, 22), (688, 685, 22), and (519, 698, 22) respectively, then proceed north for 84m and subsequently east for 91m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Five-drone coordinated maneuver: Drone 17, Drone 14, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 5 lift off to 22m elevation, hold formation positions at (483, 418, 22), (617, 465, 22), (810, 495, 22), (688, 685, 22), and (519, 698, 22) respectively, then travel north 84 meters and east 91 meters in sequence. The specified directional distances must be achieved by each drone, adapting position to circumvent any obstacles.
